title: E2E.Adversarial.Many.Salted.Entries.Wrong.2026-TESTGRP
description: adv-rar5-many-salted-entries' 512 encrypted members, submitted once with no password and once with a wrong one, with a configured password list that holds only wrong passwords. Every member has its own salt, so every candidate costs a key per member, derived off the pipeline turn. Each job fails with the password verdict, once.
